_desc: Sender bursts 200 packets at SF7 every 50ms. Receiver toggles its RX SF every 50ms between SF7 and SF8 — only frames arriving while it's tuned to SF7 should be heard. Each toggle opens a sf_switch_delay_ms blind window, dropping any preamble landing inside (drop_rx_blind). With sf_switch_delay_ms=5 and 200 toggles, expect ~10–60 drop_rx_blind events; rest are either rx (when on SF7) or drop_sf_mismatch (when on SF8). Asserts existence — exact counts depend on phase alignment.
